text:
We came here for acne extraction and injections, while my partner came for a facial treatment. The staff were friendly, polite, and gentle. We didn't have to wait long. Credit cards are accepted for bills over 1,000 baht.
Parking is available right in front of the shop.

text:
I've been a regular customer for a while now and will continue to be. The staff are all friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable.
The prices are reasonable, with some procedures being cheaper than other clinics. They don't push sales to the point of being intimidating. Parking is available. The atmosphere is pleasant and the shop is very clean. I primarily use their skin drip service and see clear results. I definitely won't go anywhere else.
